blurb: Every `requires` and `ensures` clause has a name, and a failure report points at a clause by that name, so each name must be unique within one function, across both kinds. Rename the repeat; the error is on its name.
example:
fn inc(x: Int) -> Int
  requires bigger: x > 0
  ensures bigger: result > x      // ✗ `bigger` is already taken

fn inc(x: Int) -> Int
  requires positive: x > 0
  ensures bigger: result > x      // ✓
summary: A function declares two contract clauses (`requires`/`ensures`) with the same name.
